label: AbiO system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses a single-component AbiO-family locus represented by DefenseFinder as a mandatory AbiO__AbiO profile.
observations: AbiO branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual AbiO__AbiO profiles, the abiO gene, predicted restriction-endonuclease or helicase interpretations, unresolved AbiO phage triggers, unresolved arrest or death routes, source database rows naming one AbiO model, and generic abortive infection systems.
